title: Universal domain catalog entry
description: One entry in shared/registry/catalog/domains.yaml — the domain's OWN repository maturity (D0-D5, Section 15), independent of any one person's exposure. Post-Codex fix (P2-01): this catalog previously reused domain.schema.json (personal exposure entries), which forced it to carry a fake 'universal exposure' field mirroring personal EXPOSURE vocabulary — the exact ownership violation Codex flagged ('universal catalog must not own personal exposure state'). Personal exposure belongs ONLY in 01-SALIM-BURAK-DIGITAL-TWIN/registry/domain-state.yaml, validated against domain.schema.json.

maturity.description: Section 15 domain maturity model — repository content depth, never a person's exposure level.

path.description: Repository-relative path to this domain's README, if one exists yet (D0 entries may have none).
